ach_vassalize_athens_for_reward.en: Should we succeed in subjugating [athens_country.GetName], we will be able to install a new ruler favorable to [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]

flavor_ach.1.desc.en: Following the [target_country2.GetAdjective] invasion of [target_country.GetName], the rightful heir of [target_character.GetFather.GetName], [target_character.GetShortName], was ousted by [GetCharacter('byz_andronikos_iii_palaiologos').GetName] and replaced by the current [target_country2.GetAdjectiveWithNoTooltip] governor, [GetCharacter('epi_theodoros_synadenos').GetName]. Thankfully, [target_character.GetShortNameWithNoTooltip] was smuggled out of the country by the anti-[target_country2.GetAdjectiveWithNoTooltip] faction and brought before [target_character2.GetName].

flavor_ach.10.a.en: Now is the time to drive back the [byz_country.GetLongNameWithNoTooltip]!

flavor_ach.10.a.entry.en: Now is the time to drive back $BYZ$!

flavor_ach.10.b.en: Wait to see if rumors of [byz_country.GetAdjectiveWithNoTooltip] instability bear fruit.

flavor_ach.10.b.entry.en: Wait to see if rumors of $BYZ_ADJ$ instability bear fruit.

flavor_ach.10.desc.en: Following the success of the Fourth Crusade in 1204, [ShowAreaName('morea_area')] became one of the many regions that would be conquered by the crusaders in the aftermath of the collapse of [byz_country.GetName]. However, in recent decades, the [byz_country.GetAdjectiveWithNoTooltip] elite have retaken portions of the region, although most of it still remains under [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] control.\n\nWith rumors of instability gripping the [byz_country.GetAdjectiveWithNoTooltip] [byz_country.GetGovernment.GetCourtTitle], several advisors within the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetGovernment.GetCourtTitle] believe now would be an opportune time to launch a campaign to reclaim the lost territories and expel [byz_country.GetAdjectiveWithNoTooltip] influence from [ShowAreaNameWithNoTooltip('morea_area')] for good.

flavor_ach.11.a.en: Now is the time to crush the Phoenix!

flavor_ach.11.b.en: Let us avoid involving ourselves in [byz_country.GetAdjectiveWithNoTooltip] internal affairs.

flavor_ach.11.b.entry.en: Let us avoid involving ourselves in $BYZ_ADJ$ internal affairs.

flavor_ach.11.desc.en: Although [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] spies in the [byz_country.GetGovernment.GetCourtTitle] of [byz_country.GetName] have brought back rumors of political instability for some time now, recent reports speculate that [byz_country.GetAdjectiveWithNoTooltip] [byz_country.GetGovernment.GetEstateName('nobles_estate')] have grown infuriated with the ruling [byz_ruler.GetDynasty.GetName], and are now plotting a coup.\n\nSeeing this as a prelude to a potential civil war within [byz_country.GetNameWithNoTooltip], some have urged [scope_ruler.GetName] to make preparations to exploit the situation.

flavor_ach.12.c.en: Strive for a compromise with the [ShowCultureNameWithNoTooltip('greek_culture')] families.

flavor_ach.12.desc.en: Although [GetCountry('LAT').GetAdjective] rule over [ShowScriptedGeographyName('greece_geography')] has seen a decline of the former [ShowCultureName('greek_culture')] elite, in some areas of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName], members of older [ShowCultureNameWithNoTooltip('greek_culture')] families have maintained a grip on power by compromising with [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCulture.GetName] [ROOT.GetCountry.GetGovernment.GetEstateName('nobles_estate')]. However, since the fall of the [GetCountry('LAT').GetLongNameWithNoTooltip], members of the [ShowCultureNameWithNoTooltip('greek_culture')] populace have grown more resistant to [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCulture.GetNameWithNoTooltip] rule.\n\nSeeking a more stable reign, [scope_ruler.GetNameWithNoTooltip] has invited members of remaining [ShowCultureNameWithNoTooltip('greek_culture')] families in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetNameWithNoTooltip] to the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetGovernment.GetCourtTitle] to work out a compromise. However, some [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCulture.GetNameWithNoTooltip] [ROOT.GetCountry.GetGovernment.GetEstateNameWithNoTooltip('nobles_estate')] have instead pushed for further expansion of their rights over the [ShowCultureNameWithNoTooltip('greek_culture')] populace, arguing that a stronger [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCulture.GetNameWithNoTooltip] elite would clamp down on [ShowCultureNameWithNoTooltip('greek_culture')] unrest.

flavor_ach.13.a.en: We should instead befriend the [ShowCultureNameWithNoTooltip('catalan')] [athens_country.GetGovernment.GetEstateNameWithNoTooltip('nobles_estate')] in [athens_country.GetNameWithNoTooltip].

flavor_ach.13.a.entry.en: We should instead befriend the [ShowCultureNameWithNoTooltip('catalan')] $nobles_estate$ in $ATH$.

flavor_ach.13.b.en: We should honor their request to expel the [ShowCultureNameWithNoTooltip('catalan')] Company from [athens_country.GetNameWithNoTooltip].

flavor_ach.13.b.entry.en: We should honor their request to expel the [ShowCultureNameWithNoTooltip('catalan')] Company from $ATH$.

flavor_ach.13.c.en: Use the opportunity to instead conquer the [athens_country.GetFlavorRank].

flavor_ach.13.c.entry.en: Use the opportunity to instead conquer the realm.

flavor_ach.13.desc.en: Although many of the [GetCountry('LAT').GetAdjective] lords in [ShowScriptedGeographyName('greece_geography')] have offered support for [scope_ruler.GetName] and [scope_ruler.GetHisHer] claim to the [GetCountry('LAT').GetLongNameWithNoTooltip], the [athens_country.GetLongName] in recent years has grown increasingly hostile, bolstered by the backing of the [ShowCultureName('catalan')] Company. However, several discontent [athens_country.GetAdjectiveWithNoTooltip] [athens_country.GetGovernment.GetEstateName('nobles_estate')] have reached out to the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] [ROOT.GetCountry.GetGovernment.GetCourtTitle] in hopes of garnering support to expel the [ShowCultureNameWithNoTooltip('catalan')] Company from [athens_country.GetNameWithNoTooltip], and in return would offer fealty to [ROOT.GetCountry.GetNameWithNoTooltip].

flavor_ach.14.a.en: Install a member of the [ShowCultureNameWithNoTooltip('french')] [ROOT.GetCountry.GetGovernment.GetEstateNameWithNoTooltip('nobles_estate')] to serve as the new [athens_country.GetGovernment.GetRulerTitle].

flavor_ach.14.a.entry.en: Install a member of the [ShowCultureNameWithNoTooltip('french')] $nobles_estate$ to serve as the new ruler.

flavor_ach.14.b.en: Appoint a member of the [ShowCultureNameWithNoTooltip('french')] [ROOT.GetCountry.GetGovernment.GetEstateNameWithNoTooltip('nobles_estate')], but enforce privileges for the [ShowCultureNameWithNoTooltip('greek_culture')] people in [athens_country.GetNameWithNoTooltip].

flavor_ach.14.b.entry.en: Appoint a member of the [ShowCultureNameWithNoTooltip('french')] $nobles_estate$, but enforce privileges for the [ShowCultureNameWithNoTooltip('greek_culture')] people in $ATH$.

flavor_ach.14.c.en: Appoint some [ShowCultureNameWithNoTooltip('greek_culture')] [ROOT.GetCountry.GetGovernment.GetEstateNameWithNoTooltip('nobles_estate')] to take the reins of [athens_country.GetNameWithNoTooltip].

flavor_ach.14.c.entry.en: Appoint some [ShowCultureNameWithNoTooltip('greek_culture')] $nobles_estate$ to take the reins of $ATH$.

flavor_ach.14.desc.en: Having successfully bested the [ShowCultureName('catalan')] Company and exiled them from [athens_country.GetName], many of the [athens_country.GetAdjectiveWithNoTooltip] elite have pledged their full fealty to [scope_ruler.GetName]. With the former ruler of the [athens_country.GetFlavorRank] now in exile, many in the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetGovernment.GetCourtTitle] have put forth the idea of restoring a [ShowCultureNameWithNoTooltip('french')] family to rule [athens_country.GetNameWithNoTooltip], although others have suggested we take the opportunity to build relations with the [ShowCultureNameWithNoTooltip('greek_culture')] people and elevate a member of the local [athens_country.GetGovernment.GetEstateName('nobles_estate')] to serve instead.

flavor_ach.15.b.en: Use the ceremony to bolster efforts to restore the empire.

flavor_ach.15.c.en: Leverage the coronation for political favor amongst the loyal lords.

flavor_ach.15.desc.en: With the passing of [latin_empress_catherine_valois.GetName], [scope_ruler.GetName] has inherited the titular claim to the [GetCountry('LAT').GetLongNameWithNoTooltip], and has arranged a ceremony in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName] to mark the occasion. Although [latin_empress_catherine_valois.GetShortNameWithNoTooltip] and [scope_philip_latin_emperor.GetName] took major steps to reinforce the nature of the title, many of the [GetCountry('LAT').GetAdjectiveWithNoTooltip] lords throughout [ShowScriptedGeographyName('greece_geography')] have declined to recognize the [scope_ruler.GetDynasty.GetName] claim to the [GetCountry('LAT').GetLongNameWithNoTooltip].\n\nUrging [scope_ruler.GetNameWithNoTooltip] to continue building off [scope_ruler.GetHisHer] parents' legacy, some members of the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetGovernment.GetCourtTitle] have requested [scope_ruler.GetHeShe] use the ceremony to leverage renewed efforts to restore the empire.

flavor_ach.15.entry.en: The Passing of the Latin Emperorship

flavor_ach.16.a.en: Agree to the demands of the [scope_papal_states.GetAdjectiveWithNoTooltip] emissary in return for their support.

flavor_ach.16.a.entry.en: Agree to the demands of the $PAP_ADJ$ emissary in return for their support.

flavor_ach.16.b.en: We do not need [the_pope.GetShortNameWithNoTooltip] to retake [constantinople_location.GetNameWithNoTooltip].

flavor_ach.16.b.entry.en: We do not need him to retake [ShowLocationNameWithNoTooltip('constantinople')].

flavor_ach.16.desc.en:
Having taken notice of our campaigns in [ShowScriptedGeographyName('greece_geography')], [the_pope.GetName] has sent an emissary from [scope_papal_states.GetName] offering a proposal to aid us.

Recognizing our claim of [ShowGovernmentReformName('ach_heirs_of_the_latin_empire')], the [the_pope.GetShortNameWithNoTooltip] has offered the financial and political backing of [scope_papal_states.GetNameWithNoTooltip] should we agree to aid the [scope_papal_states.GetGovernment.GetRulerTitle] in [the_pope.GetHisHer] efforts to mend relations between the [ShowReligionAdjective('catholic')] and [ShowReligionAdjective('orthodox')] Churches.

[the_pope.GetNameWithNoTooltip] has also urged that should [constantinople_location.GetName] be reclaimed, the tragedy the Fourth Crusade brought upon the [constantinople_location.GetRank.GetName] must not be repeated.

flavor_ach.16.entry.en: Pope Takes Interest in restoration of the Latin empire

flavor_ach.17.a.en: It is time we reestablish our rule over [constantinople_location.GetNameWithNoTooltip].

flavor_ach.17.a.entry.en: It is time we reestablish our rule over [ShowLocationNameWithNoTooltip('constantinople')].

flavor_ach.17.b.en: We should strengthen our position before formally restoring the empire.

flavor_ach.17.c.en: Sack [constantinople_location.GetNameWithNoTooltip] for all of its remaining riches!

flavor_ach.17.c.entry.en: Sack [ShowLocationNameWithNoTooltip('constantinople')] for all of its remaining riches!

flavor_ach.17.desc.en: What was once seen as an impossible task has finally been accomplished: [constantinople_location.GetName] has finally been reclaimed! While much of the [constantinople_location.GetRank.GetName] has yet to recover, [scope_ruler.GetName] has urged [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] soldiers to be cautious while retaking [constantinople_location.GetNameWithNoTooltip] to avoid further destabilization of the populace.\n\nWith much of [constantinople_location.GetNameWithNoTooltip] secured and the Imperial palace of Blachernae abandoned, [scope_ruler.GetNameWithNoTooltip] has requested the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveWithNoTooltip] elite to quickly proclaim the restoration of the [GetCountry('LAT').GetLongName], although cautious members of the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetGovernment.GetCourtTitle] have urged us to first secure our foothold.

flavor_ach.2.desc.en: The last Latin monarch of [target_country.GetName], the young [target_character.GetName], has been smuggled out of the country to [target_country3.GetName], where the [target_country3.GetGovernment.GetRulerTitle] has been swayed to [target_character.GetHerHis] cause. There is no doubt about this — the [target_country3.GetLongName] will seek the restoration of the ousted heir.\n\nWe must beware of any invasion, for [target_character2.GetName] might strike in our moment of weakness.

flavor_ach.3.desc.en: While nominally under the rule of the Latin [target_character.GetDynasty.GetName], the influence of this ruling dynasty has been in continuous decline for many years now. The [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCulture.GetName] [ROOT.GetCountry.GetGovernment.GetEstateName('nobles_estate')] are often seen as absent and deaf to the plight of the [ShowCultureName('greek_culture')] commoners. Common folk from all walks of life have hence turned towards supporting [target_character2.GetName], a Hellenic pretender who could free [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] from the Frankish yoke.

flavor_ach.4.desc.en: Despite the fall of the [ShowFormableCountryName('LAT_f')] in 1261, its legacy lives on under the continuous line of titular Emperors up to the current Empress — [target_character.GetName]. Though merely titular, the [target_character.GetDynasty.GetName] still command much respect among the Latin states and still rule the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetLongName] — one of the most powerful remnants of the Empire.

flavor_ach.4.title.en: Influence of The Latin Empress in [ShowScriptedGeographyNameWithNoTooltip('greece_geography')]

flavor_ach.5.a.en: Let us focus on securing the local elite.

flavor_ach.5.c.en: The [ROOT.GetCountry.GetGovernment.GetCourtTitle] should begin laying the groundwork for restoration.

flavor_ach.5.c.entry.en: The court should begin laying the groundwork for restoration.

flavor_ach.5.desc.en:
Having retained the title of [GetCountry('LAT').GetAdjectiveWithNoTooltip] [GetCountry('LAT').GetGovernment.GetRulerTitle] of the [GetCountry('LAT').GetLongName], even if only titular, [scope_ruler.GetName] has maintained considerable influence with the remaining [GetCountry('LAT').GetAdjectiveWithNoTooltip] elite in [ShowScriptedGeographyName('greece_geography')], along with [scope_ruler.GetHisHer] connections in [naples_country.GetName]. Although the ploys and maneuvers of [scope_philip_latin_emperor.GetName] were intended to muster a force capable of reclaiming the empire, these plans have been abandoned since his death.

Having forged an agreement with [scope_alb_king.GetName], the rights to [albania_country.GetName] have since been sold to [scope_alb_king.GetShortNameWithNoTooltip], and the lands of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] bestowed upon [ach_heir.GetName], over which [scope_ruler.GetShortNameWithNoTooltip] has continued to rule in an official capacity.

With the [ShowCultureName('catalan')] Company in [ath_country.GetName], and rumors of instability within the [byz_country.GetGovernment.GetCourtTitle] of [byz_country.GetName], advisors close to [scope_ruler.GetNameWithNoTooltip] have suggested that an opportunity may soon emerge to restore the [GetCountry('LAT').GetLongNameWithNoTooltip] as [scope_philip_latin_emperor.GetShortNameWithNoTooltip] had envisioned.

flavor_ach.6.a.entry.en: The ruler should curry favor with the $NAP_ADJ$ court.

flavor_ach.6.b.en: Use [scope_ruler.GetShortNameWithNoTooltip]'s influence to gain monetary support.

flavor_ach.6.b.entry.en: Use his influence to gain monetary support.

flavor_ach.6.c.en: [scope_ruler.GetShortNameWithNoTooltip]'s reputation would be better used to bolster the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveWithNoTooltip] [ROOT.GetCountry.GetGovernment.GetCourtTitle].

flavor_ach.6.c.entry.en: His reputation would be better used to bolster our court.

flavor_ach.6.desc.en: Although [scope_ruler.GetName] has assumed the responsibility of managing [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName], [scope_ruler.GetHeShe] has maintained considerable influence within the [naples_country.GetGovernment.GetCourtTitle] of [naples_country.GetNameWithNoTooltip], as well as a close relationship with [nap_ruler.GetName]. Seeking to further strengthen [scope_ruler.GetDynasty.GetName] rule in [ShowScriptedGeographyName('greece_geography')], some advisors have suggested [scope_ruler.GetShortNameWithNoTooltip] use [scope_ruler.GetHisHer] influence to garner support amongst the wealthy [naples_country.GetAdjectiveWithNoTooltip] elite.

flavor_ach.7.a.en: Allow [nikephoros_ii_orsini.GetLastNameWithNoTooltip] to return to [epirus_country.GetNameWithNoTooltip] with our backing.

flavor_ach.7.a.entry.en: Allow $Orsini$ to return to $EPI$ with our backing.

flavor_ach.7.b.en: Offer to press the claim to [epirus_country.GetNameWithNoTooltip] for [nikephoros_ii_orsini.GetShortNameWithNoTooltip] instead.

flavor_ach.7.b.entry.en: Offer to press the claim to $EPI$ for $name_nikephoros.greek_language$ instead.

flavor_ach.7.c.en: It is too risky for now.

flavor_ach.7.desc.en: Having remained in the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetGovernment.GetCourtTitle] of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] for some time since his exile, [nikephoros_ii_orsini.GetName] has proven to be a valuable political asset to [scope_ruler.GetName] against the [byz_country.GetAdjective] elite. However, words have reached the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetGovernment.GetCourtTitle] that the moment to restore [nikephoros_ii_orsini.GetLastNameWithNoTooltip]'s rule may be upon us, as several [epirus_country.GetAdjective] [epirus_country.GetGovernment.GetEstateNameWithNoTooltip('nobles_estate')] have garnered enough support to launch an uprising against the [byz_country.GetAdjectiveWithNoTooltip] governor.\n\nSeeing this as an opportunity to sow further divisions within [byz_country.GetNameWithNoTooltip], many in the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetGovernment.GetCourtTitle] have urged [scope_ruler.GetNameWithNoTooltip] to take this opportunity to allow [nikephoros_ii_orsini.GetLastNameWithNoTooltip] to return to [epirus_country.GetNameWithNoTooltip].

flavor_ach.8.a.en: Let us establish a formal alliance with [epirus_country.GetNameWithNoTooltip] instead.

flavor_ach.8.a.entry.en: Let us establish a formal alliance with $EPI$ instead.

flavor_ach.8.b.en: We shall only maintain close relations with [nikephoros_ii_orsini.GetLastNameWithNoTooltip].

flavor_ach.8.b.entry.en: We shall only maintain close relations with $Orsini$.

flavor_ach.8.c.en: Now is our chance to attack!

flavor_ach.8.desc.en: News has arrived at the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] [ROOT.GetCountry.GetGovernment.GetCourtTitle] that [nikephoros_ii_orsini.GetLastNameWithNoTooltip]'s supporters have successfully reclaimed his seat in [epirus_country.GetName], and have taken the opportunity to sever [epirus_country.GetNameWithNoTooltip] from [byz_country.GetName]! While this is no doubt a major victory for [scope_ruler.GetName] towards weakening the [byz_country.GetAdjectiveWithNoTooltip] [byz_country.GetGovernment.GetCourtTitle], some in the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetGovernment.GetCourtTitle] have urged [scope_ruler.GetShortNameWithNoTooltip] to seize [epirus_country.GetNameWithNoTooltip] before [nikephoros_ii_orsini.GetShortNameWithNoTooltip] can consolidate his base of power.

flavor_ach.9.desc.en: Horrible news! [epirus_country.GetAdjective] [epirus_country.GetGovernment.GetEstateName('nobles_estate')] with the backing of [ach_scope_ruler.GetName] have launched a revolt aiming to seize [epirus_country.GetName] for [nikephoros_ii_orsini.GetName]. [epi_scope_ruler.GetName] has requested [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] intervene immediately to put down the revolt.

lat_aggressive_conversion_policies_tt.en: [the_pope.GetName] may request we adopt harsh conversion policies should we establish the [GetCountry('LAT').GetLongName], in return for earning [the_pope.GetHisHer] support

variable_ach_vassalize_athens_for_reward.en: Athens may be Vassalized as a Reward
